external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Erasmus+* is the mobility program of the European Union for students and staff of educational institutes. The objective of Erasmus+ is to promote international cooperation through the mobility of students and staff. Erasmus+ will run from 2021 to 2027.
The European Commission has awarded Universiteit Nyenrode B.V. the Erasmus Charter for Higher Education (ECHE) 2021-2027, as an individual HEI established in a program country.

Nyenrode partners with Q-Park, allowing you to park at a special partner rate. For 24 hours of parking, you pay €37.50 (instead of €55.00), and for 4 hours, €27.50 (instead of €36.80). For more information and reservation options, please contact us at events.amsterdam@nyenrode.nl <events.amsterdam@nyenrode.nl>.

network.coverage_note: The institution does not provide a public list of its Erasmus+ partner universities on its website, only general information about the program.
